title: Event queue
summary: Decouple when something happens from when it's handled.

cards.title: Later, in order
cards.body:
Gameplay code shouldn't stop to play a sound or animate a banner. It **posts an event** and moves on; another system processes the queue later.

A fixed-size **ring buffer** makes this allocation-free: an array with a head and a tail that wrap around.
`(tail + 1) % N` is the same circular-array trick as a reel strip. Tracking `count` separately avoids the classic "is head == tail full or empty?" ambiguity.

cards.question: Capacity 6, head = 4, size = 3. Which indices hold events?
cards.explain: Start at head and wrap: 4, 5, then (5 + 1) % 6 = 0.
